pages.title: Drinking Tea
pages.text: Each infusion is 250 mB. Drinking any infusion returns the tea cup.$(br2)Different infusions grant different status effects, listed by tea type below.

pages.title: The Six Base Teas
pages.text: $(li)Green Tea: Haste II for 60 seconds + Night Vision for 5 minutes.$(li)White Tea: Haste I for 60 seconds + Night Vision for 5 minutes.$(li)Yellow Tea: Haste II for 3 minutes + Speed II for 3 minutes.$(li)Red Tea: Haste II for 3 minutes + Speed II for 3 minutes.$(li)Dark Tea: Resistance II for 3 minutes + Absorption I for 3 minutes + Regeneration I for 10 seconds.$(li)Oolong Tea: Haste II for 5 minutes + Speed II for 5 minutes.

pages.title: Flower Teas
pages.text: $(li)Jasmine Flower Tea: Regeneration I for 20 seconds + Night Vision for 5 minutes.$(li)Gardenia Flower Tea: Haste I for 3 minutes + Regeneration I for 20 seconds.
